correctness.rationale: The fixed-k exact centered coefficient sum c_(k+r)=sum_A W_m(A) W_m(mr-kA), with m=n+k, is the coefficient of the frozen reciprocal degree-2k polynomial. The compact piecewise-quadratic trapezoidal estimate gives normalized coefficient and derivative error O_k(m^-2) against (s^2+4s+1)(1+...+s^(k-1))^2. The exact Fejér value at theta_j=2pi j/k is m sin^2(pi j/k)/sin^2(pi h_j(m)/k), with mh congruent j mod k. Scaling theta=theta_j+u/m yields a_kj u^2+6k^2 sin^2(pi j/k)/sin^2(pi h/k) with distinct imaginary roots, giving the displayed delta and O_k(m^-2) complex error via Rouché. A negative real simple root and k-1 interior/outer splits account for all 2k roots. Finite independent k=5,n=201 tent/Fejér/root checks corroborate but do not establish uniform infinite asymptotics. The result fixes k; it does not cover growing k or all two-variable zeros.
